describe: The image shows a wall of pale grey, beige and greenish bricks laid in running bond, about 9 rows with thin light mortar lines. The bricks are weathered with dark stains and small chips, and the lower rows are darker brown. A single vertical dark brown riveted iron strip runs down the centre, with about 8 round rivets per side and some rust. Colours are muted sage, cream, grey and rust brown, with even lighting. The iron strip and its rivets must stay exactly in place.
